body.name: Residual stable endpoint
body.construction: \(S_{\alpha,H}\) is the centered infinitely-divisible law obtained by pushing \(\alpha s^\kappa ds\,H(dr,du)\) through \((s,r,u)\mapsto r/s\); equivalently its positive and negative Lévy tails are \(x^{-\alpha}E_H[(R_+)^\alpha]\) and \(x^{-\alpha}E_H[(R_-)^\alpha]\).
